title: Durable run progress event
description: Constitution Part 22.4. Progress is an event stream, not animation. Events are STORED BEFORE DELIVERY so a browser refresh or temporary closure never loses progress, and the renderer can never become the source of truth (Part 25.5.1 rule 6).

sequence.description: Monotonic per run. Clients resume with ?since=<sequence>.

message.description: Plain language for the operator. Never a stack trace (Part 22.8).

action_required.description: True moves the run to WAITING_FOR_USER with one direct instruction (Part 22.5).

question_id.description: POST /api/runs/{id}/answer validates against this exact id (Part 25.5).
